commands: git status --porcelain; echo "---RUN_ID---"; echo "run_id=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-UNSET} attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-UNSET}"; echo "---PR VIEW---"; gh pr view 1780 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,state,title,body --jq '{head:.headRefName,base:.baseRefName,baseOid:.baseRefOid,headOid:.headRefOid,state:.state,title:.title}'

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
